title: STS2 Tracker v1.3.9 - Canonical Spire Accolades Showcase & Rarity Badging
changelog: Complete 41 Canonical Accolades Catalog: Integrated all official Slay the Spire 2 accolades directly from the game engine localization and bytecode

Instant Rarity Identification: Badges and chips now feature distinct Gold 🥇, Silver 🥈, and Bronze 🥉 metallic styling, glowing borders, and medal icons for immediate at-a-glance recognition without hovering
Full Accolades Pursuit Section: Players can now view all 41 accolades—including unearned ones with 🔒 0x locked styling and precise unlock criteria—to pursue in future climbs

Multi-Tier Accolade Dynamic Resolution: Accurately distinguishes tiered achievements like Flawless (Bronze 1 boss), Supreme (Silver 2 bosses), and Perfect (Gold 3 bosses), as well as Elite Hunter / Killer / Slayer and Healer tiers
Interactive Accolade Tabs & Filtering: Filter by All (41), Earned, In Pursuit, or specific Gold / Silver / Bronze rarities with a single click
notes: Full canonical 41-accolade showcase with Gold/Silver/Bronze instant rarity badging and unearned pursuit tracker.
